Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the age comparison. After correctly identifying the directors and their birth years—Erich von Stroheim (1885) and Mario Missiroli (1934)—the Planner incorrectly concluded that Stroheim was younger and selected The Devil's Pass Key. In fact, Missiroli (born 1934) is younger, so La bella di Lodi should have been the answer.
